import json
import os
import yaml
from pathlib import Path

def _target_format():
    """'html'/'pdf' for the current render, or None when unknown (then treat as HTML)."""
    info_path = os.environ.get("QUARTO_EXECUTE_INFO")
    if info_path:
        try:
            return json.load(open(info_path))["format"]["pandoc"]["to"]
        except Exception:
            return None
    return None

data = yaml.safe_load(Path(os.environ.get("ITINERARY_DATA", "itinerary.yml")).read_text())
trip = data["trip"]
stops = data["stops"]

#| echo: false
#| warning: false
from IPython.display import display, HTML, Markdown
import datetime as _dt
import html as _html

def _resources_html(s, with_url=False):
    items = []
    for r in s.get("resources", []):
        name = _html.escape(str(r["name"]))
        if r.get("url"):
            shown = f'<a href="{_html.escape(str(r["url"]))}" target="_blank">{name}</a>'
            if with_url:
                shown += f" ({_html.escape(str(r['url']))})"
            items.append(shown)
        else:
            items.append(name)
    return "<br>".join(items)

# Group stops by coordinates into "places". Each place gets one number (by
# first appearance) that is reused across the agenda and the route map, so a
# multi-day stay shows one marker/number instead of stacked dots.
_loc_index = {}
_loc_num_of = []
loc_groups = []
for _s in stops:
    _key = (round(float(_s["lat"]), 4), round(float(_s["lon"]), 4))
    _n = _loc_index.get(_key)
    if _n is None:
        _n = len(loc_groups) + 1
        _loc_index[_key] = _n
        loc_groups.append(
            {"num": _n, "name": str(_s["location"]),
             "lat": _s["lat"], "lon": _s["lon"], "stops": []}
        )
    loc_groups[_n - 1]["stops"].append(_s)
    _loc_num_of.append(_n)

def _days_label(_group_stops):
    _days = []
    for _s in _group_stops:
        try:
            _days.append(_dt.date.fromisoformat(str(_s["date"])).day)
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            return "Multiple days"
    if len(_days) == 1:
        return f"Day: {_days[0]}"
    _runs = []
    for _d in sorted(_days):
        if _runs and _d == _runs[-1][-1] + 1:
            _runs[-1].append(_d)
        else:
            _runs.append([_d])
    _parts = [f"{_r[0]}–{_r[-1]}" if len(_r) > 1 else str(_r[0]) for _r in _runs]
    return "Days: " + " & ".join(_parts)

for _g in loc_groups:
    _g["day_text"] = _days_label(_g["stops"])

# Numbered places are shown with circled-digit glyphs (1 → ❶ ① ... 20 → ⑳),
# sized naturally along the location text like the map markers' own numbers.
# 21+ falls back to plain digits.
def _circled(_n):
    return chr(0x2460 + _n - 1) if 1 <= _n <= 20 else str(_n)

rows = ""
for i, s in enumerate(stops, 1):
    activities = "<br>".join(f"• {a}" for a in s["activities"])
    rows += f"""
    <tr>
      <td><strong>{s['date']}</strong></td>
      <td>{s['location']}&nbsp;{_circled(_loc_num_of[i-1])}</td>
      <td>{s['accommodation']}</td>
      <td>{s['transport']['mode']}<br><em>{s['transport']['notes']}</em></td>
      <td>{activities}</td>
      <td>{_resources_html(s)}</td>
    </tr>"""

html_table = f"""
<style>
  .itinerary-table {{ width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:0.9em; }}
  .itinerary-table th {{ background:#2c3e50; color:white; padding:10px; text-align:left; }}
  .itinerary-table td {{ padding:10px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd; vertical-align:top; }}
  .itinerary-table tr:hover {{ background:#f5f5f5; }}
</style>
<table class="itinerary-table">
  <thead>
    <tr>
      <th>Date</th><th>Location</th><th>Accommodation</th><th>Transport</th><th>Activities</th><th>Resources</th>
    </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>{rows}</tbody>
</table>
"""

# PDF: condense the table into the example's two-column "gutter agenda" —
# a narrow date + weekday column on the left, the day's details on the right,
# one row per stop so days flow naturally across pages.
_agenda_rows = ""
for i, s in enumerate(stops, 1):
    try:
        _dd = _dt.date.fromisoformat(str(s["date"]))
        _gutter = (
            f'<span style="font-size:18pt">{_dd.month}/{_dd.day}</span><br>'
            f'<span style="font-size:10pt">{_dd.strftime("%a").upper()}</span>'
        )
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        _gutter = "<strong>" + "<br>".join(_html.escape(str(s["date"])).split("-")) + "</strong>"
    _details = [
        f'<span style="font-size:18pt">{_html.escape(str(s["location"]))}&nbsp;{_circled(_loc_num_of[i-1])}</span>'
    ]
    _transport = [str(s["transport"]["mode"])]
    if s["transport"].get("notes"):
        _transport.append(str(s["transport"]["notes"]))
    _details.append(
        "<strong>Transport</strong>:&nbsp;<em>" + _html.escape(" — ".join(_transport)) + "</em>"
    )
    _details.append("<strong>Stay</strong>:&nbsp;" + _html.escape(str(s["accommodation"])))
    _details.extend(f"&nbsp;&nbsp;•&nbsp;{_html.escape(a)}" for a in s["activities"])
    if s.get("resources"):
        _details.append(_resources_html(s, with_url=True))
    _agenda_rows += f"""
    <tr>
      <td class="agenda-gutter">{_gutter}</td>
      <td class="agenda-details">{'<br>'.join(_details)}</td>
    </tr>"""

agenda_table = (
    "<style>"
    "  .agenda-table { width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; }"
    "  .agenda-table td { padding:4px 8px; border-bottom:1px solid #e0e0e0; vertical-align:top; }"
    "  .agenda-gutter { white-space:nowrap; font-weight:bold; color:#2c3e50; width:12%; text-align:center;"
    "                   border-right:2px solid #2c3e50; font-size:1.05em; }"
    "  .agenda-gutter strong { color:#2c3e50; }"
    "  .agenda-details { font-size:0.92em; }"
    "  .agenda-details a { color:#2c3e50; }"
    "</style>"
    '<table class="agenda-table">'
    '<colgroup><col style="width:12%"><col style="width:88%"></colgroup>'
    "<tbody>" + _agenda_rows + "</tbody></table>"
)

if _target_format() in (None, "html"):
    display(HTML(html_table))
else:
    display(HTML(agenda_table))

# Top-level `notes` are rendered as their own section right after the agenda
# (open-ended reference material, e.g. a food cheat sheet), so they don't get
# mistaken for one day's resources.
_notes_md = ""
for _n in (data or {}).get("notes") or []:
    _title = (_n or {}).get("title", "")
    _items = (_n or {}).get("items") or []
    if not (_title or _items):
        continue
    _notes_md += f"## {_title}\n\n"
    _notes_md += "".join(f"- {_i}\n" for _i in _items) + "\n"
if _notes_md:
    display(Markdown(_notes_md))

## Route Map

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| error: false
# Always generate a static snapshot of the route; used as the PDF image
# (the HTML output gets an interactive Folium map instead).
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
from staticmap import StaticMap, CircleMarker, Line

map_img = "route-map.png"

def _lon_to_x(lon, zoom):
    return (lon + 180.0) / 360.0 * 2**zoom

def _lat_to_y(lat, zoom):
    lat = max(min(lat, 90), -90)
    r = math.radians(lat)
    return (1.0 - math.log(math.tan(r) + 1 / math.cos(r)) / math.pi) / 2.0 * 2**zoom

m = StaticMap(900, 560, padding_x=40, padding_y=40)

coords = [[s["lon"], s["lat"]] for s in stops]
m.add_line(Line(coords, "#000000", 1))

# One marker per place (from the agenda cell's grouping), not per day, so a
# multi-day stay reads as a single dot with a callout instead of stacked dots.
for g in loc_groups:
    m.add_marker(CircleMarker((g["lon"], g["lat"]), "#000000", 14))

# Auto-fit to the tightest zoom that shows every stop. A trip-level `zoom`
# acts as a ceiling on that, so a single-location trip (e.g. one campsite)
# still shows the surrounding roads instead of zooming all the way in.
try:
    trip_zoom = int(trip["zoom"]) if trip.get("zoom") else None
except (TypeError, ValueError):
    trip_zoom = None

if trip_zoom is not None:
    img = m.render(zoom=min(m._calculate_zoom(), trip_zoom))
else:
    img = m.render()

# Number each place marker and add a callout for multi-day stays. Positions
# replicate staticmap's own Web-Mercator projection so labels land exactly.
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
_font_paths = (
    os.path.expanduser("~/.fonts/OpenSans-Bold.ttf"),
    "OpenSans-Bold.ttf",
    "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf",
    "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/open-sans/OpenSans-Bold.ttf",
)
def _load_bold(size):
    for _p in _font_paths:
        try:
            return ImageFont.truetype(_p, size)
        except OSError:
            continue
    return ImageFont.load_default()

font_num = _load_bold(16)
font_name = _load_bold(12)
font_days = _load_bold(10)

def _marker_px(lon, lat):
    return m._x_to_px(_lon_to_x(lon, m.zoom)), m._y_to_px(_lat_to_y(lat, m.zoom))

def _overlaps(a, b):
    return not (a[2] <= b[0] or a[0] >= b[2] or a[3] <= b[1] or a[1] >= b[3])

def _truncate(text, width):
    while text and draw.textlength(text, font=font_name) > width:
        text = text[:-1]
    return text

_R, _GAP = 14, 10
_PADX, _PADY, _LH = 7, 4, 15

def _fit_callout(px, py, w, h, placed):
    # Candidate offsets around the marker; first one that fits wins.
    cand = (
        (px + _R + _GAP, py - h / 2, (px + _R + _GAP, py)),
        (px + _R + _GAP, py - _R - _GAP - h, (px + _R + _GAP, py - _R - _GAP)),
        (px + _R + _GAP, py + _R + _GAP, (px + _R + _GAP, py + _R + _GAP)),
        (px - _R - _GAP - w, py - h / 2, (px - _R - _GAP, py)),
        (px - _R - _GAP - w, py - _R - _GAP - h, (px - _R - _GAP, py - _R - _GAP)),
        (px - _R - _GAP - w, py + _R + _GAP, (px - _R - _GAP, py + _R + _GAP)),
    )
    for x0, y0, anchor in cand:
        box = (x0, y0, x0 + w, y0 + h)
        if x0 < 0 or y0 < 0 or x0 + w > img.width or y0 + h > img.height:
            continue
        if any(_overlaps(box, b) for b in placed):
            continue
        return box, anchor
    return None, None

placed_callouts = []
for g in loc_groups:
    px, py = _marker_px(g["lon"], g["lat"])
    num = str(g["num"])
    _bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), num, font=font_num)
    _tw, _th = _bbox[2] - _bbox[0], _bbox[3] - _bbox[1]
    draw.text((px - _tw / 2 - _bbox[0], py - _th / 2 - _bbox[1]),
              num, fill="white", font=font_num)

for g in loc_groups:
    if len(g["stops"]) < 2:
        continue
    px, py = _marker_px(g["lon"], g["lat"])
    name = _truncate(str(g["name"]), 280)
    days = g.get("day_text") or "Multiple days"
    w = int(max(draw.textlength(name, font=font_name),
                draw.textlength(days, font=font_days))) + 2 * _PADX
    h = 2 * _PADY + 2 * _LH
    box, anchor = _fit_callout(px, py, w, h, placed_callouts)
    if box is None:
        continue
    draw.line([(px, py), anchor], fill="#000000", width=1)
    draw.rounded_rectangle(box, radius=4, fill="#ffffff", outline="#000000", width=1)
    draw.text((box[0] + _PADX, box[1] + _PADY), name, fill="#000000", font=font_name)
    draw.text((box[0] + _PADX, box[1] + _PADY + _LH), days, fill="#000000", font=font_days)
    placed_callouts.append(box)

img.save(map_img, format="PNG")
```

def _place_marker(g):
    stays = "<br>".join(_html.escape(str(s["accommodation"])) for s in g["stops"])
    popup_html = (
        f"<b>Loc {g['num']} — {_html.escape(g['name'])}</b><br>"
        f"{g.get('day_text', '')}<br><i>{stays}</i>"
    )
    return folium.Marker(
        location=[g["lat"], g["lon"]],
        popup=popup_html,
        tooltip=f"{g['num']} · {g['name']}",
        icon=folium.DivIcon(
            html=f'<div style="background:#000;color:#fff;font-family:Open Sans,sans-serif;'
                 f'font-weight:bold;width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;'
                 f'display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;'
                 f'font-size:14px;">{g["num"]}</div>',
            icon_size=(24, 24),
            icon_anchor=(12, 12),
        ),
    )

for g in loc_groups:
    _place_marker(g).add_to(m)

folium.PolyLine(
    [[s["lat"], s["lon"]] for s in stops],
    color="#2c3e50", weight=2, dash_array="10",
).add_to(m)

# Only the HTML output shows the interactive map; other formats use the
# static PNG generated above, so suppress Folium output here for them.
import json
def _target_format():
    info_path = __import__("os").environ.get("QUARTO_EXECUTE_INFO")
    if info_path:
        try:
            return json.load(open(info_path))["format"]["pandoc"]["to"]
        except Exception:
            return None
    return None

if _target_format() in (None, "html"):
    _display(m)
else:
    _ = None

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| error: false
#| output: asis
import calendar as _cal_mod
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
from datetime import date
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen

def _target_format():
    info_path = os.environ.get("QUARTO_EXECUTE_INFO")
    if info_path:
        try:
            return json.load(open(info_path))["format"]["pandoc"]["to"]
        except Exception:
            return None
    return None

def _py_cal(year, month):
    lines = [f"{_cal_mod.month_name[month]} {year}".center(20)]
    lines.append("Su Mo Tu We Th Fr Sa")
    for week in _cal_mod.Calendar(firstweekday=6).monthdayscalendar(year, month):
        lines.append("".join(f"{d:>2} " if d else "   " for d in week).rstrip())
    return "\n".join(lines)

def _fetch_cal(year, month):
    """`cal <month> <year>` text via cal/busybox/Python, ANSI codes stripped."""
    exe = shutil.which("cal")
    if not exe:
        exe = shutil.which("busybox")
    text = _py_cal(year, month) if not exe else ""
    if exe and not text:
        args = [exe] if "busybox" not in exe else [exe, "cal"]
        try:
            cp = subprocess.run(args + [str(month), str(year)],
                                capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
            text = cp.stdout or _py_cal(year, month)
        except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
            text = _py_cal(year, month)
    text = re.sub(r"\x1b\[[0-9;]*[A-Za-z]", "", text)
    return [ln.rstrip() for ln in text.splitlines()]

# Itinerary dates grouped by month: {(year, month): {day, ...}}
trip_days = {}
for s in stops:
    try:
        d = date.fromisoformat(s["date"])
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        continue
    trip_days.setdefault((d.year, d.month), set()).add(d.day)

def _cal_grid(lines):
    """Turn `cal` text rows into Sun-first week lists of day numbers."""
    weeks = []
    for ln in lines[2:]:
        if not ln.strip():
            continue
        row = [""] * 7
        for m in re.finditer(r"\d{1,2}", ln):
            row[min(6, m.start() // 3)] = int(m.group(0))
        weeks.append(row)
    return weeks

def _md_calendar(year, month, days, with_note=True, heading=False):
    grid = _cal_grid(_fetch_cal(year, month))
    if not grid:
        return ""
    rows = ["| Su | Mo | Tu | We | Th | Fr | Sa |",
            "|:--:|:--:|:--:|:--:|:--:|:--:|:--:|"]
    for week in grid:
        cells = "| {} | {} | {} | {} | {} | {} | {} |".format(
            *["**" + str(d) + "**" if d in days else (str(d) if d else "&nbsp;") for d in week]
        )
        rows.append(cells)
    if heading:
        header = f"### {_cal_mod.month_name[month]} {year}"
    else:
        header = f"**{_cal_mod.month_name[month]} {year}**"
        if with_note:
            header += " — itinerary dates in **bold**"
    return header + "\n\n" + "\n".join(rows)

calendar_md = ""
for (year, month), days in sorted(trip_days.items()):
    calendar_md += _md_calendar(year, month, days) + "\n\n"
if not calendar_md:
    calendar_md = "_No dated stops to highlight._\n\n"

# PDF variant: same grids, but bare centered month headings (no note).
calendar_pdf_md = ""
for (year, month), days in sorted(trip_days.items()):
    calendar_pdf_md += _md_calendar(year, month, days, heading=True) + "\n\n"

# --- Weather ---
weather_md = "_No stops with coordinates for a forecast._"
if stops:
    try:
        lat, lon = stops[0]["lat"], stops[0]["lon"]
        url = ("https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast"
               f"?latitude={lat}&longitude={lon}"
               "&daily=weather_code,temperature_2m_max,temperature_2m_min"
               "&timezone=auto&forecast_days=16")
        req = Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "itinerary-maker/1.0"})
        with urlopen(req, timeout=20) as resp:
            daily = json.load(resp)["daily"]
        by_date = {d: (c, hi, lo) for d, c, hi, lo in zip(
            daily["time"], daily["weather_code"],
            daily["temperature_2m_max"], daily["temperature_2m_min"])}
        _wmo = {
            0: "Clear", 1: "Mainly clear", 2: "Partly cloudy", 3: "Overcast",
            45: "Fog", 48: "Fog",
            51: "Light drizzle", 53: "Drizzle", 55: "Drizzle",
            56: "Freezing drizzle", 57: "Freezing drizzle",
            61: "Light rain", 63: "Rain", 65: "Heavy rain",
            66: "Freezing rain", 67: "Freezing rain",
            71: "Light snow", 73: "Snow", 75: "Heavy snow", 77: "Snow grains",
            80: "Light showers", 81: "Showers", 82: "Heavy showers",
            85: "Snow showers", 86: "Snow showers",
            95: "Thunderstorm", 96: "Thunderstorm w/ hail", 99: "Thunderstorm w/ hail",
        }
        rows = ""
        for s in stops:
            d = s["date"]
            if d not in by_date:
                continue
            code, hi, lo = by_date[d]
            rows += f"| {d} | {_wmo.get(code, 'Unknown')} | {hi:.0f}° / {lo:.0f}° |\n"
        if rows:
            weather_md = (
                f"**Forecast for {stops[0]['location']}**\n\n"
                "| Date | Conditions | High / Low |\n"
                "|------|-------------|------------|\n" + rows
            )
        else:
            weather_md = "*No forecast yet — Open-Meteo covers the next 16 days from today.*"
    except Exception:
        weather_md = "*Weather forecast unavailable (no network access at render time).*"

_fmt = _target_format()
_info = "### Calendar\n\n" + calendar_md + "### Weather\n\n" + weather_md
if _fmt in (None, "html"):
    print(_info)
else:
    # PDF: single column — full-width route map, then the calendar (bare
    # month header only) and the forecast below it.
    print("![Route map with numbered places](route-map.png){width=100%}")
    print("")
    print(calendar_pdf_md.strip())
    print("")
    print("### Weather\n\n" + weather_md)
```
